info.title: MobileProxy.Space API
info.description:
Official API for [MobileProxy.Space](https://mobileproxy.space) — private mobile proxies on real GSM devices across 52 countries, 240 cities, and 223 carriers.

## Authentication

All API requests (except IP rotation) require a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN
```

Get your token from the [Dashboard](https://mobileproxy.space/en/user.html).

## Localization

Some endpoints support the `Accept-Language` header (`en` or `ru`) to return localized names for countries, cities, etc.

## Rate Limits

- **Identical requests:** no more than once every 5 seconds. Error: `"Too many lonely requests. Timeout 5 second"`
- **All API methods:** max **3 × (number of active proxies)** requests per second. Error: `"Too many requests per second"`. Example: 10 proxies → 30 req/s, 100 proxies → 300 req/s.
- **IP rotation** (`changeip.mobileproxy.space`): **no rate limit**.

## SDKs

- **PHP**: `composer require mobirox/mobileproxy-sdk` — [GitHub](https://github.com/mobileproxy/php-sdk) | [Packagist](https://packagist.org/packages/mobirox/mobileproxy-sdk)
- **Node.js**: `npm install @mobileproxy/sdk` — [GitHub](https://github.com/mobileproxy/node-sdk) | [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mobileproxy/sdk)
- **Python**: `pip install mobileproxy-sdk` — [GitHub](https://github.com/mobileproxy/python-sdk) | [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/mobileproxy-sdk/)

get.description:
Find out what IP address your proxy is currently issuing.
Optionally check if the IP is in spam databases via [IPGuardian.net](https://ipguardian.net).

parameters.name: proxy_id
parameters.description: Proxy ID. For multiple proxies, separate with commas: `1,2,3,4`

parameters.name: check_spam
parameters.description: Set to `true` to check IP against spam databases (IPGuardian.net)

proxy_id.description: Object where keys are proxy IDs and values are their current IP addresses

found.description: Whether the IP was found in spam databases

sources.description: List of databases where IP was found (if applicable)

get.description: Get a list of your active purchased proxies with all details including connection credentials, expiration, GEO, and operator info.

parameters.name: proxy_id
parameters.description: Filter by specific proxy ID(s). Comma-separated for multiple: `1,2,3,4`. Omit for all.

get.description: Get statistics of mobile proxy IP addresses grouped by GEO.
Change the login and password for one or more proxies. If not specified, credentials are auto-generated.

parameters.name: proxy_id
parameters.description: Proxy ID (comma-separated for multiple: `1,2,3,4`)

parameters.name: proxy_login
parameters.description: New login (only numbers and Latin letters). Auto-generated if omitted.

parameters.name: proxy_pass
parameters.description: New password (only numbers and Latin letters). Auto-generated if omitted.

get.description: Reboot the modem/equipment assigned to this proxy.
Change settings for one or more existing proxies — IP rotation timer, IP-based auth, auto-renewal, auto equipment change, and comments.

parameters.name: proxy_id
parameters.description: Proxy ID (comma-separated for multiple: `1,2,3,4`)

parameters.name: proxy_reboot_time
parameters.description: IP change timer in minutes. Send `0` to disable.

parameters.name: proxy_ipauth
parameters.description: IP addresses for auth without login/password (comma-separated IPv4). Supports subnets. Send `-1` to disable. Example: `192.168.34.76,123.123.212.0/24`

parameters.name: proxy_auto_renewal
parameters.description: Auto-renewal: `1` = enabled (default), `0` = disabled

parameters.name: proxy_auto_change_equipment
parameters.description: Auto equipment change scope: `0` = off, `1` = unrestricted, `2` = same country, `3` = same region, `4` = same city

parameters.name: proxy_comment
parameters.description: Text comment (max 255 chars)

get.description:
Rotate the proxy IP address. **No rate limit** on this endpoint.

Does **not** require Authorization header — only the proxy key and a valid User-Agent.

The proxy key is found in your dashboard: My Proxies → Change IP column.

parameters.name: proxy_key
parameters.description: Proxy key (varchar(32)), found in the Change IP link under My Proxies

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format: `json` for JSON, `0` for plain text

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.description: Must be a real browser User-Agent (not a bot)

code.description: 200 on success, other codes indicate specific errors

get.description: Switch the modem/SIM card assigned to a proxy. Optionally filter by operator, GEO, country, city, or specific equipment ID. Can add current equipment to blacklist.

parameters.name: proxy_id
parameters.description: Proxy ID (comma-separated for multiple: `1,2,3,4`)

parameters.name: operator
parameters.description: Operator name (from `get_operators_list`)

parameters.name: geoid
parameters.description: GEO ID (from `get_geo_list`)

parameters.name: id_country
parameters.description: Country ID (from `get_id_country`)

parameters.name: id_city
parameters.description: City ID (from `get_id_city`)

parameters.name: eid
parameters.description: Specific equipment ID

parameters.name: add_to_black_list
parameters.description: Add current equipment to blacklist before switching. `1` = yes, `0` = no

parameters.name: check_after_change
parameters.description: Set to `true` to get the new IP address in the response

parameters.name: check_spam
parameters.description: Set to `true` to check new IP against spam databases (IPGuardian.net)

message.description: Successful changes: keys = proxy IDs, values = success messages

error.description: Failed changes: keys = proxy IDs, values = failure reasons

checked.description: IP check results (if `check_after_change=true`): keys = proxy IDs, values = IP addresses

get.description: Get available equipment grouped by GEO and operator, with count of free ports.

parameters.name: proxy_id
parameters.description: If specified, shows servers you can switch this proxy's GEO to

parameters.name: equipments_back_list
parameters.description: If present, excludes equipment from the blacklist

parameters.name: operators_back_list
parameters.description: If present, excludes operators from the blacklist

parameters.name: show_count_null
parameters.description: Show items with 0 available count. Default: false

count_free.description: Object: keys = operator names, values = available equipment count

get.description: Get list of available GEOs with free port counts. Optionally filter by proxy for GEO-switching options.

parameters.name: proxy_id
parameters.description: If specified, shows GEOs you can switch this proxy to

parameters.name: geoid
parameters.description: GEO ID(s) to filter. Comma-separated for multiple: `1,2,3,4`

get.description: Get list of mobile operators, optionally filtered by GEO with free port counts.

parameters.name: geoid
parameters.description: GEO ID(s). Comma-separated for multiple: `1,2,3,4`

get.description: Get list of all countries. Supports `Accept-Language` header (`en` or `ru`).

parameters.name: only_avaliable
parameters.description: If set to `1`, returns only countries with available equipment and their counts

get.description: Get list of all cities. Supports `Accept-Language` header (`en` or `ru`).

id_city.description: Object: keys = city IDs, values = arrays with city ID, country name, and city name

get.description: Get the blacklist of equipment and operators for a proxy.

parameters.name: proxy_id
parameters.description: Proxy ID (comma-separated for multiple: `1,2,3,4`)

get.description: Block a specific operator for a proxy.
Unblock an operator. If no parameters specified, clears the entire operator blacklist.

parameters.name: proxy_id
parameters.description: Proxy ID (comma-separated for multiple)

get.description: Remove equipment from blacklist. If no parameters specified, clears the entire equipment blacklist.

parameters.name: proxy_id
parameters.description: Proxy ID (comma-separated for multiple)

parameters.name: black_list_id
parameters.description: Blacklist entry ID

parameters.name: eid
parameters.description: Equipment ID

get.description: Purchase a new proxy or extend an existing one. Use `amount_only=true` to get the price without actually buying.

parameters.name: id_country
parameters.description: Country ID (from `get_id_country`)

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Rental period in days. Default: 30

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: Number of proxies to purchase. Default: 1

parameters.name: operator
parameters.description: Preferred operator (from `get_operators_list`)

parameters.name: coupons_code
parameters.description: Discount coupon code

parameters.name: auto_renewal
parameters.description: Auto-renewal: `1` = on (default), `0` = off

parameters.name: proxy_id
parameters.description: Extend existing proxy ID(s). Comma-separated for multiple.

parameters.name: amount_only
parameters.description: If `true`, returns the price without purchasing

get.description: Request a refund for a proxy.
Get your current account balance.
Get proxy prices for specific countries. Supports `Accept-Language` header and currency parameter.

parameters.name: id_country
parameters.description: Country ID(s). Comma-separated for multiple: `1,2,3,4`

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency: `usd` or `rub` (default: `rub`)

get.description: Get a free 2-hour trial proxy for testing.
Get the history of balance transactions (payments, purchases, refunds).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Offset for pagination. Default: 0

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Number of records to return. Default: 50

post.description:
Anti-cloaking tool — fetch a URL's content using IP addresses from different countries.
Creates an async task. Use `getTaskResult` to retrieve the results after `approximate_end_time`.
If `id_country` is omitted, the page is fetched from all available countries.

id_country.description: Country ID(s), comma-separated. Omit for all countries.

approximate_end_time.description: Approximate completion time — query results after this

get.description: Get the result of an async task. If `tasks_id` is omitted, returns all user tasks.

parameters.name: tasks_id
parameters.description: Task ID (from `see_the_url_from_different_IPs`). Omit to get all tasks.

tasks_result.description: Results: keys = country IDs, values = arrays with URL and page content

get.description: Check if specific equipment (modem) is occupied or available for rent.

parameters.name: eid
parameters.description: Equipment ID(s). Comma-separated for multiple: `1,2,3,4`

eid.description: Keys = equipment IDs, values: `0` = occupied, `1` = available

BearerAuth.description: API token from your dashboard. Pass as `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`.
